Choose a first question, explore its historical context or go directly to a dialogue. These pages offer orientation, not a replacement for Plato's own arguments.

The transmitted Platonic corpus contains questions of attribution and chronology. Reader guides make these distinctions visible where they matter.

## How to use these resources

Read one page, choose a dialogue passage and write down a question and an objection. Return to the guide after reading the text, not instead of reading it. There is no required reading order.
